control._why: Few creatures to hit, so cut cheap creature removal. Clarion Conqueror is a flying threat that also shuts off planeswalker and artifact abilities; Sheltered by Ghosts exiles a planeswalker or key permanent.

midrange._why: Sunspine Lynx is a bigger body that stops lifegain; Sheltered by Ghosts answers a big threat. Cuts the slow and fragile cards.

aggro._why: Authority of the Consuls slows their attackers and gains life; Seam Rip and Erode remove cheap threats. Cuts the slow cards.
